scientific_question: Are the 63 independently detected controlled-drum PulseCandidates the same events as the 63 authoritative symbolic drum onset positions?

ground_truth_asset.path: recordings/validation/ground_truth/03 THE COST OF LIVING versione intro + 8 bar.musicxml

declared_rendering_context.temporal_origin: MusicXML score time zero = WAV sample zero

measurement.derivation: One detector timestamp cell: hop_length_samples / sample_rate_hz.

correspondence_rule.edge: absolute detected-minus-expected error <= one timestamp-resolution cell
correspondence_rule.assignment: A correspondence exists only where each symbolic onset has exactly one candidate edge and each candidate has exactly one symbolic edge; observations are never reused.
correspondence_rule.exact_match: detected timestamp equals expected timestamp exactly
correspondence_rule.complete: All symbolic onsets and all PulseCandidates participate in the unique one-to-one correspondence.
correspondence_rule.partial: At least one unique one-to-one correspondence exists, but unmatched symbolic onsets or candidates remain.
correspondence_rule.not_yet_knowable: Declared origin or measurement information is insufficient to evaluate correspondence.

prohibited: Ground Truth access before blind observation freeze
